senses.gloss:
mn. (-णः-णं)
The residence of low or outcast tribes.
E.
पच to cook, कण aff. and क substituted for च.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be cooked or dressed.
2 To be matured.
3 To be digested.
E.
पच to cook, &c. तव्य aff.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Cooking, ripening.
2 Fame, respectability.
E.
पच to cook, aff. क्तिन्.

n. (-लं)
Inflammation of the bowels, cholic.
E.
पक्ति, and शूल cholic.

mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ)
Who or what ripens or cooks.
m. (-क्ता)
The digestive faculty.
E.
पच to cook, &c. तृच् aff.

n. (-क्त्रं)
The sacred fire to be maintained perpetually by the householder.
E.
पच to mature, Uṇādi aff. त्र.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Ripe, ripened, matured, cooked.
E.
पच to cook, &c. aff. क्त्रि and मप् added.

ind.
Having cooked, dressed, matured, &c.
E.
पच to cook, क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
1 Mature, dressed, cooked, matured by nature or by art.
2 Fully matured, on the eve of rottenness or decay.
3 Perfect, come to perfection.
4 Able, shrewd, experienced, mature, as the understanding.
5 Grey, (the hair.)
6 Digested.
E.
पच to cook or ripen, व substituted for क्त aff.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Cooking, maturing, who or what does so
m. (-त्)
The Nimb tree.
E.
पक्व ripe, and कृत् what makes; the leaves of the plant are applied to phlegmonoid swellings, to induce suppuration.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Grey-haired.
E.
पक्व, and केश the hair.

m. (-सः)
Wine or vinous liquor.
E.
पक्व matured, रस juice.

n. (-रि)
1 Rice gruel.
2 Boiling water.
3 Distilled water.
E.
पक्व boiled, वारि water; also read पङ्कवारि.

n. (-न्नं)
Dressed food.
E.
पक्व, and अन्न food.

m. (-यः)
The abdomen, the stomach.
E.
पक्व, and आशय receptacle.

f. (-का)
A burnt or baked brick.
E.
पक्व, and इष्टका a brick.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (पक्षति पक्षयति)
1 To take or accept.
2 To take a part or side.

m. (-क्षः)
1 The half of a lunar month or fortnight, comprising fifteen days.
2 A wing; (it is also neuter in this sense.)
3 The feather of an arrow.
4 A partisan.
5 A friend.
6 A side, a flank.
7 An army, forces.
8 A house.
9 An argument, a thesis, a position advanced, doctrine to be maintained.
10 Contradiction, opposition, rejoinder, reply.
11 The subject of an inference.
12 Alternative.
13 A tribe, a class.
14 The ash pit of a fire place.
15 A royal elephant.
16 (In composition with words signifying hair,) Quantity, as केशपक्ष much or abundant hair.
17 A bird.
18 A bracelet.
19 Purity, perfection.
20 A limb, a member.
21 A tail.
22 (In Arithmetic,) Side of an equation in a primary division.
E.
पक्ष to take, aff. अच् or पण to transact business, Uṇādi aff. स, and क substituted for the radical final.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
1 Belonging to a half month.
2 Relating to a side or party, &c.
E.
पक्ष, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A private or back door.
2 A side.
3 A sidesman, an associate, a confederate or partisan.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
1 The moon.
2 An elephant.
3 An attendant, a constant companion.
E.
पक्ष a fortnight, &c. चर who goes.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced in a fortnight, &c.
m. (-जः)
The moon.
E.
पक्ष a fortnight, and ज born.

m. (-न्मा)
The moon.
E.
पक्ष, and जन्मन् birth: see the last.

f. (-ता)
1 The nature or essential character of a proposition.
2 The taking up a side or argument.
3 Maintaining or defending a thesis.
E.
तल् added to पक्ष; also with त्व, पक्षत्वं.

f. (-तिः-ती)
1 The first day of the half month.
2 The root or insertion of a wing.
E.
पक्ष a fortnight, &c. तिन् aff. and ङीष् optionally added.

n. (-यं)
1 A month.
2 Both sides of an argument, &c.
E.
पक्ष, and द्वय two.

n. (-रं)
A private entrance, an inner or back door.
E.
पक्ष a side, and द्वार a door.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Who or what has a part or side, a wing, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 The moon.
2 A bird.
3 A partisan.
E.
पक्ष a half month, धर who has.

m. (-तः)
1 Adopting a side or an argument whether right or wrong, partisanship.
2 A partisan, an adherent, who or [] what sides with.
3 The moulting of birds considered to proceed from fever.
E.
पक्ष, and पात who causes to go, or पक्ष a wing, and पात falling.

f. (-ता)
Adherence, friendship, fellowship.
E.
पक्षपातिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, पक्षपातित्वं.

m. (-ती)
A partisan, a friend, an adherent.
E.
पक्षपात, and इनि aff.

m. (-लिः)
A private or back door.
E.
पक्ष a side, and पालि a point, &c.

m. (-गः)
1 The side or flank of an elephant.
2 The side in general.
E.
पक्ष the side, and भाग a part.

n. (-लं)
The root or articulation of a wing.
E.
पक्ष a wing, and मूल a root.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Winged.
2 Having a side or party.
E.
पक्ष, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-नः)
A bird.
E.
पक्ष a wing, and वाहन vehicle.

m. (-न्दुः)
A heron.
E.
पक्ष a feather, and विन्दु a spot.

m. (-सः)
A wing.
E.
पक्ष as above, असि aff.

m. (-रः)
A sort of tree, commonly Lodh.
E.
पक्ष a part, सुन्दर handsome.

m. (-तः)
1 Refutation, confuting.
2 Palsy, hemiplegia.
E.
पक्ष, and आघात a blow.

m. (-न्तः)
The fifteenth and last day of either half month, new or full moon.
E.
पक्ष a fortnight, and अन्त end.

n. (-रं)
Another side or part, another view of the argument.
E.
पक्ष, and अन्तर difference.

m. (-सः)
1 A seeming or fallacious argument.
2 A false plaint.
E.
पक्ष, and आभास semblance.

m. (-लुः)
A bird.
E.
पक्ष a wing, आलुच् poss. aff.

m. (-रः)
The last day of either half month, new or full moon.
E.
पक्ष a fortnight, and अवसर conclusion.

mf. (-क्षी-क्षिणी)
A bird.
m. (-क्षी)
An arrow.
f. (-णी)
1 A night and two days.
2 Day of full moon.
3 A female fiend, also called Pūtanā.
E.
पक्ष a wing, and इनि poss. aff.

f. (-का)
A trough for watering birds, cattle, &c.
E.
पक्षिन् a bird, पाणीय water, शाला a hall, and कन् diminutive aff.

m. (-जः)
King of the birds, usually applied to Garuḍa.
E.
पक्षिन्, and राज for राजा king.

m. (-लः)
A name of the saint VĀTSYĀYANA.
E.
पक्ष to take, इलच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A young bird.
E.
पक्षिन्, and शावक a young animal.

f. (-ला)
A nest, an aviary.
E.
पक्षिन् a bird, शाला a hall or house.

m. (-हः)
A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
E.
पक्षि for पक्षिन् a bird, सिंह pre-eminent.

m. (-मी)
GARUḌA.
E.
पक्षि, and स्वामिन् lord: see the last.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Showing partiality, taking a side.
E.
पक्ष, and उद्ग्राहिन् taking.

पक्ष्णु^1
mfn. (-क्ष्णुः-क्ष्णुः-क्ष्णु)
Who or what cooks or matures.
E.
पच to ripen, स्नु aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160315. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/252. note: 'zn' usually not possible. Confirm MW and other dictionaries.

n. (-क्ष्म)
1 An eye-lash.
2 The filament of a flower.
3 The point of a thread.
4 A wing.
E.
पक्ष to take, मनिन् aff.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
1 Produced or occurring in a fortnight.
2 Belonging to a side, &c.
E.
पक्ष, and यत् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Maturity, natural or artificial, as the state of being cooked or ripened.
2 Cooking, dressing food.
3 A vessel in which any thing is dressed, a saucepan, a boiler, &c.
4 Digestion, assimilation of food.
5 Suppuration, ripeness of a boil.
6 Greyness of the hair.
7 General panick, or the subversion of a country.
8 Fear.
9 An owl.
10 The name of a demon.
mf. (-कः-का)
The young of animals.
E.
पच to be or become ripe, aff. घञ्, or पा to nourish, Uṇādi aff. कन्.

m. (-ष्णः)
The Caronda tree, (Carissa carondas.)
E.
पाक ripening, कृष्ण black; bearing a black fruit when ripe; also other similar compounds, as पाककृष्णफल, कृष्णपाक, &c.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced by cooking, maturing, &c.
n. (-जं)
1 Black salt.
2 Flatulence.
E.
पाक, and ज born.

n. (-चं)
A cooking utensil, a boiler, &c.
E.
पाक, and पात्र a vessel.

f. (-टी)
A potter's kiln.
E.
पाक backing, पुट to heap, aff. क and ङीप्.

m. (-लः)
The Caronda.
E.
पाक ripe, फल fruit, (black, understood): see पाककृष्णफल; also पाकफलकृष्ण, फलपाक, &c.

n. (-ण्डं)
A culinary utensil.
E.
पाक, and भाण्ड a vessel.

m. (-त्स्यः)
Fish sauce.
E.
पाक cooking, मत्स्या fish.

m. (-ज्ञः)
An oblation offered on building a house, liberating a bull, &c. or a religious rite of four kinds, oblation to the VIŚVADEVAS, offerings to the spirits, the permanent obsequial rites, and hospitality.
E.
पाक, and यज्ञ sacrifice; the distribution of food being part of each of these ceremonies.

m. (-कः)
The performer of the ceremony called Pākayajña.
E.
पाकयज्ञ, aff. ठञ्.

n. (-नं)
The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
E.
पाक cooking, रञ्ज to colour, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Producing maturity.
2 Suppurative, producing suppuration in a boil.
n. (-लं)
A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.)
m. (-लः)
Fever in an elephant.
f. (-ली)
A sort of cucumber, (C. utilatissimus.)
E.
पाक ripeness, ला to get, aff. ड.

m. (-लिः)
A sort of plant, (Bauhinia candida.)

f. (-ला)
A kitchen.
E.
पाक cooking, शाला a hall.

m. (-नः)
INDRA.
E.
पाक a demon, शासन ruling, overcoming.

m. (-निः)
The son of INDRA.
E.
पाकशासन INDRA, इञ् aff. of descent.

f. (-क्ला)
Chalk.
E.
पाक cooking, burning, शुक्ल white.

n. (-नं)
A kitchen.
E.
पाक cooking, स्थान a place.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Cooked, dressed, ripened, naturally or artificially.
E.
पाक cooking, इमनिच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A cook.
E.
पच to cook, Uṇādi aff. णुकन्.

mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
What may or is to be cooked, matured, &c.
n. (-क्यं)
Bitloben, a medicinal salt, impregnated with iron.
m. (-क्यः)
Nitre, saltpetre.
E.
पच to cook, aff. ण्यट्.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Belonging to or occurring in a Pakṣa or fortnight, &c.
E.
पक्ष half month, &c. and फक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging to a bird, to a fortnight, to an argument, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A fowler, a bird catcher.
2 An alternative.
E.
पक्ष a fortnight, or पक्षिन् a bird, aff. ठञ्.
